title: SLO lifecycle trace for token paths and circuit replay workflow
creator: Liam Chen
description: Goal: Build an instrumentation and dashboard surface that traces the entire SLO lifecycle for individual token paths (ingress -> shard -> decode -> kv -> egress), links circuit breaker state transitions across regions, and provides a replayable 'circuit replay' simulator for incident repro and policy tuning. This ticket covers schema design, telemetry enrichment, storage shape for short-term traces, a visual explorer (dashboard) and a light-weight simulator that can replay sampled traffic through fallback/circuit rules to measure SLI deltas. Why: existing dashboards show aggregate p95/p99 by route and region but we cannot easily answer: 'Which token cohorts triggered the regional circuit flip and how did token latency and admit rates change after redispatch?' Deliverables: 1) Metric and trace schema (names and tag keys) for token-path SLI events and circuit-state deltas; 2) Sampling plan and prefix-aware retention; 3) Grafana/Explorers: token-path SLO lifecycle view, delta heatmap pre/post-failover, and a circuit-replay panel that can run on sampled traces; 4) A small simulator service (k8s job) that can replay stored traces against policy engine to produce expected admit/latency distributions; 5) Runbook additions for incident RCA that reference the new panels. Out of scope: full-fidelity per-token raw logs for all traffic (too high cardinality).
metrics_schema: Metric names: inference.token_path.sli_latency_ms, inference.token_path.sli_error, inference.token_path.admit, inference.circuit.state_change, inference.circuit.redispatch_count. Tags: region, route, model_version, shard_id, priority_tier, token_length_bucket, kv_hit (true/false), admission_decision (admit/evict/queue), fallback_target. Each metric is emitted with a trace_id and token_path_id for short-lived joins in the explorer.
sampling_plan: Prioritize: 100% sampling for errors and circuit state changes, 10% uniform sampling for successful requests, 50% sampling for tail latency > p95. Use prefix-aware harvesting for high-volume customers to bias sampling toward customer prefixes when customer impact is suspected. Retain sampled traces for 14 days in hot storage (explorer) and aggregate rollups for 90 days.
dashboard_requirements: Panels: 1) SLO lifecycle trace viewer (search by trace_id or token_path_id) showing time-series of per-step latency and circuit state annotated; 2) Pre/Post fallback delta heatmap (region x token_length_bucket) showing p50/p95/p99 before and after failover; 3) Circuit event timeline with linked top-k token_path samples; 4) Replay control that runs simulator on selected samples and shows expected admit/latency distributions; 5) Top causes table (kv_hit fraction, model_version, shard hotspot). Provide CSV/JSON export for selected samples.
implementation_notes: Instrumentation: add lightweight token_path span within existing trace (open-telemetry compatible). Emit explicit circuit.state_change events with previous_state, new_state, reason, and capacity_metadata. Use existing golden signals: latency (per-step), errors (decode, model, transport), saturation (admit rate, queue length). Storage: use a short-lived timeseries store for metrics and an object store (compressed ndjson) for sampled traces with an index by trace_id. Simulator: reuse policy engine logic (admit/shed/redispatch) as a library and run deterministic replays on sampled traces. Backpressure: ensure simulator runs in a read-only mode against policy definitions and cannot modify live router state.
runbook_updates: Add sections: 1) How to pivot from aggregate SLO alerts to trace-level explorer; 2) Steps to run the circuit-replay simulator for a given incident and interpret delta plots; 3) Guidance on tuning sampling knobs during high-severity incidents; 4) Escalation matrix when replay shows mismatched behavior between simulator and production.
qa_plan: Unit tests for metric emission and tag correctness. Integration test: end-to-end synthetic trace injection that triggers a regional circuit flip in staging and validates explorer panels. Load test: verify sampling pipeline can sustain 10k sampled traces/min during staging soak. Beta: ship to a single on-call team and run two-week shadowing with no alerting changes.
